llm.summary: The skill is a disclosed Instantly/Superagnt integration, but it exposes broad account-admin, billing, purchasing, API-key, and workspace-owner controls beyond ordinary outreach workflows.

dimensions.detail: Calls go to api.superagnt.com and mcp.superagnt.com for the stated integration, so external transmission is expected, but the connected account may expose business, lead, email, billing, and workspace data.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The package is documentation-only and requires SUPERAGNT_API_KEY plus curl; it also offers an optional external MCP server setup URL, which is disclosed but outside the reviewed artifact.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill tells agents to confirm destructive or outbound actions and explicitly discloses admin/billing/procurement endpoints, but the same skill still makes high-impact operations available under one broad integration without stronger scoping.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No local persistence, services, or executable payloads were found, but API-key creation/deletion and workspace owner/member changes can affect durable account access and control in the connected Instantly workspace.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is cold email campaign, lead, analytics, and account-settings management, but the documented endpoint surface also includes DFY account orders, billing details, API-key lifecycle, workspace membership, domain settings, and ownership transfer.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Review this before installing if you only need outreach automation. Use it only with an account/key whose permissions you are comfortable exposing to campaign, lead, email, billing, API-key, procurement, and workspace-admin actions, and require explicit confirmation before sends, deletes, purchases, key changes, billing changes, or workspace membership/ownership changes.
llm.findings:
[SDI-1] unexpected: The artifact itself confirms a broader administrative surface than normal campaign outreach, including billing, API-key, workspace, and procurement operations.
[SDI-2] unexpected: The DFY email account order endpoint can place account orders and includes a simulation flag whose false value may result in real ordering or charges.
[SDI-2] unexpected: The API-key endpoints allow listing, creating, and deleting credentials, which is high-impact account administration rather than routine outreach.
[SDI-2] unexpected: Workspace member, group, domain, and owner-change endpoints are privileged controls that materially exceed ordinary campaign management.
[E1] expected: The external Superagnt API URL is the disclosed integration endpoint and is necessary for this curl-based skill; I did not find hidden exfiltration behavior in the artifact.
